title: Key aphid natural enemies showing positive effects on wheat yield through biocontrol services in northern China
authors: Ali A, Desneux N, Lu Y, Wu K
location: Langfang Experimental Station, Hebei Province, China (116.4°E, 39.3°N)
design: RCBD with 3 blocks; 3 cage types (exclusion 1x1mm mesh excluding all natural enemies, restriction 2x2mm mesh excluding predators but allowing parasitoids, open field with full natural enemy access); 6 replicates per treatment; cultivar Shi mai-8
notes: Yield measured only in 2011 and 2012 (not 2013). Yield ANOVA reports F(2,14) implying 17 rather than 18 observations — one sample may have been lost. Pest abundance (aphid density) measured all 3 years. All yield values sourced from Fig. 5A; no tabulated numeric yield data. Pest abundance means reported in text (Section 3.1). Statistical analyses used SAS 9.2 with SNK test at alpha=0.05. Paper states ± SEM throughout.

observations.treatment_description: exclusion cage with 1x1mm mesh openings — no entry of any predator or parasitoid; aphids fully protected
observations.control_description: open field cage with four bamboo wood sticks without mesh — natural enemies had complete access to aphids

moderators.predator_group: all natural enemies (coccinellids + Aphidius gifuensis parasitoids)

figure_read.located_by: caption search — confirmed right-hand panel on page 6
figure_read.structure: Two groups on x-axis (2011, 2012); 3 bars per group: Black=restriction cage, Gray=exclusion cage, White=open field cage; y-axis 'Average wheat yield (±SEM) for exclusion cages field (kg/ha)'; ticks at 0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000; spacing 500; linear; caption states error bars are SEM; letters above bars show SNK grouping (alpha=0.05)
figure_read.evidence_note: Fig 5A p6; 2011 gray bar (exclusion cage); bar top sits between 1000 and 1500 ticks, approximately 90% of the way from 1000 to 1500 (~1450); letter 'b' above error bar. Control (white bar, open field): ~2550, SEM ~250. Direction check: exclusion yields less than open field — consistent with expected biocontrol effect.

observations.unit: mean aphids per 100 tillers (season mean across sampling dates)
observations.data_source: text, Section 3.1, p3 (PDF page 3); values confirmed against Fig. 1 bars (PDF page 4)
observations.treatment_description: exclusion cage with 1x1mm mesh — no predator or parasitoid access; highest season mean aphid density
observations.control_description: open field cage — full natural enemy access; lowest season mean aphid density
observations.notes: Means stated in text: 'the lowest mean number of aphids (49 per 100 tillers) was recorded in the open field cages, whereas the highest mean number of aphids (2439 per 100 tillers) was recorded in exclusion cages.' These are overall season means across multiple sampling dates (May 23 to June 16, 2011). SEM shown as error bars in Fig. 1 but not numerically reported and not readable at figure scale for open field bar (value 49 on 0-6000 axis). Direction: exclusion increases pest abundance as expected. By June 11, exclusion had 100-fold population growth from initial 5 aphids/tiller release.
